main_text.l: 346. Maria virgo, mater Christi, fuit non solum eiuf-

& cognatione, nempe Dauidica: ita vt personae a Mat-
thaeo & Luca commemoratae, vtraque pertineant ad tri-
bum Iudae.
347. Iosephus, fuit Mariae adiunctus quasi tutor, defen-
sor, & testis, ut ita haberet caput, a quo regeretur & pro-
tegeretur una cum Christo filio, & assertorem pudicitiae.
348. Zacharias, pater Iohannis, fuit sacerdos sed non
summus, ex classe Abiae.
349. Elisabetha, mater Iohannis, fuit ex filiabus Aha-
ron, eademque cognata Mariae virginis; non quod Maria
fuerit e tribu Leui, sed quia pater Elisabethae sibi iunxe-
rat uxorem e tribu Iuda & cognatione B. virginis.
350. Magi ab oriente, qui Christum recens natum inui-
ferunt, non Arabes fuere, sed Persae, & quidem regulı,
hoc est, toparchae ditionis Pe-sicae.

page.notes: Page number 348 printed at top left; running head TRIUMPHUS at top centre. Line numbers 5 to 35 are in the right margin and are kept as notes. "ro[?]" in 351 is printed where the year 10 is expected; read as printed and uncertain. "Pe-sicae" is hyphenated as printed; the reading of the word is uncertain. "Iu-dae æ." shows a doubled æ as printed, uncertain. "F,à" is punctuated as printed. Faint "A" near "Anti-" in 351 and the stray ">" beside "Chal-" are not printed text and are not transcribed. Catchword "uanda." is at the foot right, the continuation of "obser-".
